name: WithSecureLabs/chainsaw
description: A rapid Windows forensic artifact searching and threat hunting tool written in Rust. Provides fast Sigma rule detection against event logs, MFT analysis, and Shimcache/Amcache execution timeline creation for quick incident triage.
score_rationale: Widely-used Windows forensic triage tool with 3.5k stars and a February 2026 release, favored for its speed and integration with Sigma detection rules.
